verdict: CONNECTED AND ROBUST — like the cell. The layers ARE wired in: removing localization or STRING directly drops the engine (0.887→0.851/0.858), so a change propagates to the answer. But knocking out an artifact does NOT crash the software — the dependent syscall runs DEGRADED via a fallback (a backup pathway), exactly like a cell buffering a gene knockout. The honest catch is the SAME as the cell's: this robustness can HIDE damage — a corrupted layer silently lowers accuracy unless you RE-RUN the audit (which regenerates and re-checks the number). Connectivity is real at the reasoning layer; it is NOT a live signal — most modules are batch scripts writing artifacts, wired through the reason engine + ID backbone, not a continuously-propagating network.
